{"drafts":[{"title":"Clarifying How llama.cpp's HTTP Server Combines Uploaded Files with Prompts?","body":"I've been looking into how the file upload button in llama.cpp's HTTP server actually combines the uploaded file content with the prompt I type. One user speculated that the server might just concatenate the file content and the prompt into a single input string, but this hasn't been confirmed. 

This user was running llama 3.2 3B Q4_K_S and noticed that answers to questions about the uploaded file were inconsistent, which makes me wonder if the way the file and prompt are combined could be causing this variability. Does anyone here know more about the exact mechanism behind this or have insights into why the responses might be unreliable when querying the uploaded file?

Understanding this could help clarify whether the issue lies in how the input is constructed or elsewhere in the pipeline.
